title: Book Two · Chapter 131: A Book for Mum
story:
Early summer brings longer evenings. Mum moves her chair to the doorway after supper. She has a book from a friend. The cover shows a garden.

Ronan sits on the step with his school page.

“Is that for work?” he asks.

“No.”

“Are you making a garden bag?”

“No. I want to read it.”

He looks at the cover again. He has seen Mum read notes and customer names all his life. Now she is reading a book just for herself.

“Can I see?”

She shows him one picture, then turns the page back to her place.

“I am here.”

Ronan opens his own story. In it, a man builds a little wall around a tree. A child asks why the wall has a gap. The answer is on the next page.

Ronan reads slowly. Mum's pages make a soft sound beside him. At the gate, Mr Qiu closes a wooden box and lifts it clear of the path. The black cat passes under his chair.

After a while, Dad brings three cups. He looks at the two readers.

“Do I need a book to sit here?”

“A cup is enough,” Mum says.

Dad sits on the low stool. He points to the garden cover.

“I could build that bench.”

“You could read about the flowers first.”

“Very small chairs for them?”

Mum laughs and moves her cup away from the book. Ronan watches them for a moment. Then he reaches the answer in his own story.

“The gap is for the old man,” he says.

Dad turns.

“What gap?”

Ronan explains the wall and the path. He shows the picture. The old man can reach the tree through a clear space.

Dad asks, “Does he own the tree?”

Ronan looks back at the page. It does not say.

“I do not know. It says he sits there each morning.”

“Then tell me that part.”

Ronan reads the short line aloud. Mum listens, then returns to her garden book.

The evening air grows cooler. Mrs Lan comes through with a basket. Dad lifts his stool so she has room. Mr Qiu says good night from the gate.

Ronan reaches the end of the story. He wants to tell Mum, but she is still reading. He waits until she looks up.

“Finished?”

“Yes.”

“Good ending?”

“Yes. The boy makes the gap wider.”

Mum smiles. “Room for the cup, too?”

Ronan looks at Dad on the stool. “And large knees.”

Dad raises his cup. Mum closes her book around a plain marker. They sit a little longer. The sky grows dark beyond the bright doorway.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

gap＝缺口；bench＝长凳；marker＝书签；own＝拥有。

## 理解问题

1. Mum读书是否为了顾客工作？
2. Ronan对文本没写明的树归属怎样回答？

## 读句子

**Dad / raises / his cup.** Dad／举起／他的杯子。
